onboard_device_owner.title: Enable Device Owner for Kiosk Satellite
onboard_device_owner.description:
Device Owner gives Kiosk Satellite full control of this device.

**Benefits**
- Kiosk Satellite updates install silently, with no on-screen prompt.
- True kiosk lock: the app can pin itself so users cannot leave it.
- Kiosk Satellite can make itself the home app without a prompt.
- Remote reboot from Home Assistant.
- The real Wi-Fi MAC address is readable.

**Side effects**
- It cannot be undone except by a factory reset. Kiosk Satellite cannot be uninstalled normally while it is Device Owner.
- To enroll, the accounts below are removed from the device. Their app is removed for a moment and then reinstalled. On a Meta Portal this removes the Portal's Meta login: KSM then opens Meta's setup screen on the Portal, and you finish setup and the WhatsApp login there.
- Some OEM features that need an account (for example Meta's calling and apps) may stop working until you sign in again.

**Accounts on this device**
{accounts}

Tick the box and submit to proceed. Nothing on the device changes until you do. Leave it unticked to skip Device Owner; the device is added either way.

meta_setup.title: Set up the Portal's Meta login again
meta_setup.description:
Kiosk Satellite is already Device Owner, but this Portal's Meta login is gone (Device Owner enrollment removes it). KSM can put Meta's setup screen back on the Portal: it turns kiosk mode off, resets Meta's setup app and opens it. You then finish setup and the WhatsApp login on the Portal, and KSM turns kiosk mode back on once the Meta login is back.

Tick the box and submit to show the setup screen.

confirm.title: Trust the new HTTPS key for {name}?
confirm.description:
Kiosk Satellite at {host} is presenting a different HTTPS key than the one Home Assistant pinned. This is expected after using "Replace certificate" in Kiosk Satellite or after a factory reset; otherwise someone may be intercepting the connection. Until you confirm, Home Assistant will not send the device any credentials or settings.

Submit to trust the key the device is presenting now.

voice_satellite_missing.title: Install Voice Satellite for your kiosks?

confirm.title: Install Voice Satellite?
confirm.description:
Kiosk Satellite uses the Voice Satellite integration to talk to Assist. It is not installed, so each kiosk's voice satellite has to be set up by hand.

Submit to download Voice Satellite (jxlarrea/voice-satellite-card-integration) through HACS. Kiosk Satellite Manager then creates a Voice Satellite entry for each kiosk, reusing any that already has the kiosk's name, and points the kiosk at it. To keep setting it up by hand, ignore this repair instead.

abort.hacs_missing: HACS is not installed. Install HACS first, or install Voice Satellite manually, then restart Home Assistant.
abort.repository_unknown: HACS does not know the Voice Satellite repository. Add jxlarrea/voice-satellite-card-integration to HACS as a custom integration repository, then try again.
abort.download_failed: HACS could not download Voice Satellite. Check the Home Assistant log, then try again.
abort.restart_required: Voice Satellite was downloaded. Restart Home Assistant to finish; the kiosks are set up automatically after the restart.
